subject: Re: EmberLynx pilot — request for commit flex top-up, credit & trial runway
messages:
From: Claire Chen <claire@emberlynx.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus@emberlynx.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2029 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension — request for additional credits + runway

Ben — thanks again for the demo last week. EmberLynx's engineering team is seeing promising results but needs a bit more runway to validate accuracy at scale. Two asks: 

1) Top-up the pilot credits by 150k tokens (we burned through the initial allocation faster than expected due to longer context tests).
2) Extend the private trial by an additional 30 days so we can run the VPC-based integration and finish compliance review.

We're close to agreeing on a 12-month commitment (we're comfortable with a modest MRR starting in Q3) but need the above to finish the proof-of-value. Would you be able to propose an approval path for credits + a short discount on committed rate (something like a one-time 10% ramp discount for first quarter)? Happy to share our internal evaluation notes if helpful.

Also attaching a summary of our usage and token burn (see attachment).

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Chen
Head of ML Engineering, EmberLynx
(attachment: emberlynx_usage_summary.xlsx - xlsx)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Chen <claire@emberlynx.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2029 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension — request for additional credits + runway

Hi Claire — really appreciate the context and the usage file. Agree that an extra runway makes sense given the VPC work. I need to loop in my manager and the commercial leader for an exception on combined credits + any transient discount.

Two quick clarifications so I can scope this correctly:
- The 150k tokens — is that total for the account or per-model (you mentioned 2 models in the deck)?
- Can you confirm target go-live commit window (you referenced Q3; is that July 1 target or end-of-Q3)?

I'll follow up with an internal ask and copy you on the approval thread.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: emberlynx_usage_summary.xlsx - xlsx)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2029 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot extension — EmberLynx asks (credits + trial extension + discount)

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding Claire's ask from EmberLynx. Key points: 150k token top-up, 30 day private trial extension, and a request for a short ramp discount (one-off ~10% for first quarter) contingent on a 12-month commit starting in Q3.

Why I think we should consider it:
- EmberLynx is a high-fit prospect for Dedicated/Private given their compliance needs; VPC integration will become a sticky config if successful.
- They already signaled willingness for a 12-month commit, so this is an activation/top-up ask to get to negotiation.
- Risk is modest; we can make the credit one-off and tie discount to signed PO + DocuSign within 30 days.

Requested approvals:
- Credit top-up: 150k tokens as one-time pilot grant (chargeback to growth bucket if needed).
- Trial extension: +30 days for Private trial (no extra cost).
- Discount: Exec approval required for >5% off list for initial committed rate — they're asking ~10%. If full 10% isn't acceptable, can we consider a 5% ramp plus credits?

Attachments: emberlynx_proposal_v3.pdf (proposal + usage), SOC2_summary.pdf (they asked earlier for assurance).

Ben

Subject: RE: Fwd: Pilot extension — EmberLynx asks (credits + trial extension + discount)

Aditya — Ben flagged this as a strategic onramp. My view: we should approve the credits and the 30-day VPC trial extension to remove friction. The discount is the stickier item. Proposal: approve a one-time 150k token credit and the +30 days unconditionally. For the discount, approve a conditional 6% ramp discount for the first quarter if EmberLynx signs a 12-month commit at our published committed rate (with the discount applied only for the first quarter). Require PO/DocuSign within 21 days and include standard early-termination protection (recover credits pro rata if they churn within 90 days).

Rationale: 6% buys us a faster close; the committed 12-month term is the key value. This keeps us within tolerances for non-executive approvals but still gives a small commercial concession. If Aditya wants to stretch to 10% we should ask for a second signature (CRO + Finance).

Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: EmberLynx pilot top-up + conditional discount

Agree with Marissa. Exec decision: approve the one-time 150k token pilot credit and +30 day Private trial extension. Approve a conditional 6% ramp discount on the committed rate for the first quarter only, subject to:
- Signed DocuSign PO within 21 days of this approval
- Minimum 12-month committed term
- Standard early-termination credit recovery (pro rata)

Ben: please update the proposal and attach the exec approval stamp. I'll sign off here; finance will be notified for proper chargeback coding (use code GROWTH-TOPUP-2029).

(attachment: exec_approval_stamp.pdf - pdf)

Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2029 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension — EmberLynx asks (credits + trial extension + discount) — approved

Claire — great news: execs approved the package we discussed. Summary of what we've authorized: 

- One-time pilot credit: 150,000 tokens applied to EmberLynx account upon clause acceptance.
- Private trial extension: +30 days to complete VPC integration and compliance checks.
- Conditional ramp discount: 6% off the committed rate for the first quarter only. Conditions: 12-month committed term, signed DocuSign PO within 21 days, and standard early-termination credit recovery (pro rata).

Next steps for your team:
1) I'll update the proposal to reflect the credits and conditional discount and send via DocuSign by end of today (link included).
2) Please confirm the token scope (account vs per-model) — default will be account-wide unless you request allocation per model.
3) Once signed, finance will apply the GROWTH-TOPUP-2029 code for chargeback and we'll provision the credits.
